caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair shown from the front, with a flat base and a decorative backrest. The chair has four legs, two in the front and two in the back, all colored with light brown and tan shades, with the front legs turned and a yellow band wrapped around their upper parts. The seat is woven in a diagonal checkerboard pattern using yellow and brown tones, creating a textured appearance. The backrest is arched at the top, with a wider horizontal section beneath it, both bordered in yellow and highlighted with pink and green tones. The uppermost curved panel features greenish leaf-like shapes and undulating lines. The horizontal slat below displays a floral motif with two yellow flowers and green leaves. The vertical parts of the chair back are parallel, outlined in pink with yellow highlights. The drawing is rendered in colored pencil or crayon on a pale, cream-colored background, with faint rectangular border lines framing the chair. There are no other objects or background elements present.
title: Toy Chair
